name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
summary: Maternity benefit scheme under Mission Shakti.
eligibility_categories: net family income below ₹8 lakh per annum
person with benchmark disability (40% or more) or fully disabled
benefit_summary: Official FAQ states ₹5,000 for the first child in two instalments and ₹6,000 for the second child if it is a girl, subject to scheme conditions.
documents: Aadhaar-linked bank or post-office account details
mobile number and pregnancy/child details as applicable
disclaimer: This guidance is not an official eligibility decision. Confirm current conditions and documents with the official portal or an Anganwadi worker.
